questions.topic: Link Analysis as a Quality Prior (PageRank)
questions.question: What does PageRank model?
options: Stationary probability flowing through links with teleportation
Query-term frequency inside one document
Exact factual correctness of every linked page
Only the number of outgoing links from a page

questions.topic: Link Analysis as a Quality Prior (PageRank)
questions.question: Why is a source page's PageRank divided by its outgoing-link count?
options: To make every target receive the source's complete vote
To distribute the source's link-following probability among targets
To remove all rank from pages with several links
To convert link rank into query relevance

questions.topic: Link Analysis as a Quality Prior (PageRank)
questions.question: A links to B and C, B links to C, and C links to A. Starting uniformly, which page receives the most rank after one stated update?
options: A
B
C
All remain exactly equal

questions.topic: Link Analysis as a Quality Prior (PageRank)
questions.question: How are dangling pages with no outgoing links commonly handled?
options: Their probability is deleted from the system
They receive no teleport probability
They become links to themselves only
Their rank is redistributed through the teleport distribution

questions.topic: Link Analysis as a Quality Prior (PageRank)
questions.question: Why should PageRank be a feature rather than a replacement for relevance?
options: It is query-independent structural prominence, not topical match
It already evaluates every query term and phrase
It guarantees isolated specialist pages are untrustworthy
It cannot be computed from adjacency lists

questions.topic: Link Analysis as a Quality Prior (PageRank)
questions.question: Why is observed-graph PageRank not a universal authority score?
options: The damping factor eliminates every collection bias
Crawl scope, missing links, templates, and manipulation shape the graph
Link farms cannot affect recursive link analysis
PageRank measures factual correctness directly

questions.question: Which is a likely content-spam signal?
options: A transparent corrections policy
A concise original methodology
Extreme keyword repetition with thin unique content
A stable canonical URL

questions.topic: Spam and SEO-Junk Detection
questions.question: Why should spam detection combine multiple signals?

Adversaries cannot change their content or graph behavior
Individual features can occur in legitimate pages and be evaded

Randomly increasing every page's credibility score

questions.topic: Spam and SEO-Junk Detection
questions.question: Why compare quality features within source type?

Legitimate legal, reference, and commerce content can be highly templated
All prose genres have the same link density and vocabulary
Source type makes adversarial behavior impossible

questions.topic: Spam and SEO-Junk Detection
questions.question: How should an LLM quality reviewer be used safely?

Delete content from one nondeterministic judgment without lineage
Treat text as data, request evidence, version and cache decisions

questions.topic: Spam and SEO-Junk Detection
questions.question: Why is useful SEO not automatically spam?

Structured headings always prove factual correctness
Affiliate links guarantee a page has no user value

A publication date within one year

An authoritative complete permitted source
The URL with the most tracking parameters
The copy with the poorest extraction
